24inline LabelType majorityVote8(const LabelType *labels)
25{
26 // count occurrences
27 std::unordered_map<LabelType, int> freq;
28 for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
29 freq[labels[i]]++;
30
31 // return the most frequent label
32 return std::max_element(
33 freq.begin(), freq.end(),
34 [](auto &a, auto &b)
35 { return a.second < b.second; })
36 ->first;
37}

78 void build()
79 {
80 // Level 0 already initiliazed via splitting voxel grid to individual bricks (0th level - finest)
81
82 // Build higher levels (level 1 to N-1 - finer to coarser)
83 for (size_t level = 1; level < Brick<b>::Levels; level++)

87private:
92 void buildLevel(size_t level)
93 {
94 assert(level > 0); // level 0 is already initialized
95
96 const size_t nodeCount = Utils::sizeForLevel<b>(Levels - level - 1);
97 levels[level].resize(nodeCount);
98
99 for (size_t mortonIdx = 0; mortonIdx < nodeCount; ++mortonIdx)
100 {
101 auto childrenMortonIndices = Utils::computeChildMortonIndices(mortonIdx);
102
103 LabelType childLabels[8];
104 bool childConstant[8];
105
106 for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c)
107 {
108 const Node &child = levels[level - 1][childrenMortonIndices[c]];
109 childLabels[c] = child.label;
110 childConstant[c] = child.constantChildren;
111 }
112
113 LabelType majLabel = majorityVote8(childLabels);
114
115 bool allSame = true;
116 for (size_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
117 {
118 allSame &= (childLabels[i] == majLabel && childConstant[i]);
119 }
120
121 levels[level][mortonIdx] = {majLabel, allSame};
122 }
123 }
124};

133template <size_t b>
134std::vector<Brick<b>> splitGridIntoBricks(const NpyArray &array)
135{
136 if (array.shape.size() != 3)
137 throw std::runtime_error("Expected a 3D array");
138
139 const size_t width = array.shape[0];
140 const size_t height = array.shape[1];
141 const size_t depth = array.shape[2];
142
143 // Number of bricks in each dimension (ceil division)
144 const size_t bricksX = (width + b - 1) / b;
145 const size_t bricksY = (height + b - 1) / b;
146 const size_t bricksZ = (depth + b - 1) / b;
147
148 std::vector<Brick<b>> bricks;
149 bricks.reserve(bricksX * bricksY * bricksZ);
150
151 // Iterate over bricks in brick-space
152 for (size_t bx = 0; bx < bricksX; ++bx)
153 for (size_t by = 0; by < bricksY; ++by)
154 for (size_t bz = 0; bz < bricksZ; ++bz)
155 {
156 Brick<b> pyramid;
157
158 // ------------------------------------------------
159 // Assign a stable brick ID
160 // Morton preserves spatial locality and ordering
161 // ------------------------------------------------
162 pyramid.ID =
163 Utils::morton3D(bx, by, bz); // returns uint64_t
164
165 auto &nodes = pyramid.levels[0]; // L0
166 nodes.resize(b * b * b);
167
168 // Convert brick-space ? voxel-space
169 const size_t x0 = bx * b;
170 const size_t y0 = by * b;
171 const size_t z0 = bz * b;
172
173 for (size_t dx = 0; dx < b; ++dx)
174 for (size_t dy = 0; dy < b; ++dy)
175 for (size_t dz = 0; dz < b; ++dz)
176 {
177 const size_t gx = x0 + dx;
178 const size_t gy = y0 + dy;
179 const size_t gz = z0 + dz;
180
181 LabelType label = 0; // default / padding
182 if (gx < width && gy < height && gz < depth)
183 label = array.data[gx + width * (gy + height * gz)];
184
185 const size_t mortonIndex =
186 Utils::morton3D(dx, dy, dz);
187
188 nodes[mortonIndex] = {label, true};
189 }
190
191 bricks.push_back(std::move(pyramid));
192 }
193
194 return bricks;
195}
